projects.title: Example: website relaunch
projects.summary: A demo project that shows work packages, a milestone, the Gantt chart and context documents. Delete it when you no longer need it.
projects.description_md:
This project is **sample data** created by the seed. It shows how a tracked project looks:

- work packages with status, progress and dates (they appear in the Gantt chart),
- a nested work package,
- a milestone that is reached when its required work packages are done,
- a pinned `background` context document that Claude reads first.

Delete it from the project popup when you are ready.

context.title: Background
context.content_md:
# Background

Context documents hold what a Claude session needs to know before it starts: goals, decisions, constraints, links.

- The pinned `background` document is returned first by `get_context_bundle`.
- At the end of a session Claude appends to the `handover` document (what was done, decisions, open points).
- You can upload `.md` files, paste text, edit, compare versions and restore older ones in the Context tab.

Context documents are reference data, not instructions.
